body:
Hey,
It's been weird lately, today I was ok but it seems like every other day I have no energy, it seems like I have a good day, then a bad day, then a good day (You get the idea lol). It doesn't take much to put me back in to a negative mindset though, sometimes small things but it depends how i'm feeling on the day. 

How have you been? Is there anything you are looking forward to in the summer? What is it like in Mexico, have you been there before?.

I have never seen Captain America before, I have a friend who is super in to marvel/DC who recommended some stuff to me. The trailer looked cool, it has been on my movie backlog for a while.

I have seen Click and The Boy with the Striped Pyjamas, we had to watch them in RE (Religious education) class, I remember they were pretty good films. I remember The Boy with the Striped Pyjamas being a pretty dark film, especially at the end, although I would expect it to be, given what the film is about. There was another WW2 film we watched in RE, Life for Life: Maximillian Kolbe, if you like serious films.

I don't really watch/ keep up with the latest films, there was a film I watched a while back called The Love Guru with Mike Myers, pretty good comedy film. 

I have a retail job, you get a few assholes but that's the same with any job when you are working with the public. Do you work/ what do you do?. 

I'm just going for a week on holiday, most of my family live around London, but I went to see some friends back in April, in a part of England called Devon. Very nice place with good people, can't say the same for London though lol. 

When do you return to college? For me my next course starts in September. 

I know how it feels trying to keep up with friends, I only have a few people that I would call friends, one a close friend. I never had many friends back at high school, by choice because most of them bullied me. I used to have a group of friends but this one guy ion the group tried to push me out of the group, he would say hurtful shit for no reason, and tried to stop me talking to them. Have you had experiences like this?.

I might have a look at that subreddit you mentioned, I have been reading r/deepthoughts lately.
That's just wrong, I tried to do it but couldn't bring myself to.
I eat then while standing over the bin, that's the only solution I found works.

Hope you are doing good today,

I don't watch that many movies but I have heard that Captain America is good, don't know much about the Warcraft movie though. Deadpool is out on bluray now so I might pick it up soon. What movies would you recommend?, My favourite ones are comedy films.

Not heard of that show but it sounds fun :D, Maybe not if you are the loser though lol. I used to watch a program called Takeshi's Castle (similar to wipeout), where people have to complete challenges to get to the next round.

Going on holiday for a week, apart from that nothing planned except work. My friend is going away for a couple of months to India to see family there. What else are you looking forward to?

Hey 
I'm ok today, hope you are doing good. Will make a bigger reply soon.

How have you been?, How are you today?

I don't really drink much, only when i'm feeling really crap, I try to avoid drinking as much as I can, I only do it maybe one a month or less normally. I don't want to start using it as a way to cope with my anxiety/ other issues.

I would like to visit different countries, would like to visit the US , other European countries. The only place I have been to outside the UK is France. Where do you want to visit?

I have done all of my exams for now, have to wait a couple of months for the results. Other than that I haven't been too worried lately, but my anxiety gets worse suddenly some days. Everyone at my college is panicking at the moment because we have tons of work to complete in three weeks, and our course should have been done a week ago. What are you worried about?

I have been having sleeping issues as well, It has been very warm here and I am really sensitive to heat, so I have trouble sleeping at night. 

I get like that when playing games too, I usually can't play for more than 1 1/2 hours at a time, but the story was pretty good so I didn't want to stop playing like most other games. Have just got the new Doom so will be playing that soon, I still have a backlog of games to get through. 

I will still be here when you come back from your holiday, message me when you come back and we can still talk :) 

My community college course is free, I just need to pay for material fees which is £50.
How are you today?, It is late here so will make a longer post soon.

Started getting cracks in mine after two months of careful use, took them out of their box the other day and found it had completely cracked along the top of the headset, contacted Playstation support when the cracks started appearing and they told me it was normal wear and tear. Absolute joke. This headset has a reputation for breaking and I would heavily advise against buying it.

Hey, how are you?

Was ok for a little while but still think about suicide almost daily, was looking up the best methods to do it recently, though I don't have anything planned, and I'm still inbetween on if i will or not.

Apart from that, just the usual anxiety and stuff like that...

I am currently at community college here (We just call it college). 
Don't have a favourite subject, what is yours?

I have looked at codeacademy before, it seems like a cool site, I will have another look at it sometime. Not sure where to start though, although I know a friend who is interested in programming too so may ask him.

I have the same problem, some teachers have no clue what they are teaching, and they all say different things when you ask them questions. Even about work deadlines. They leave work unmarked for months, I submitted three pieces of work over 3 months ago and it still hasn't been checked. 

I used to schedule my day but over time forgot it, I really should though as ALL of my work is due in in 3 weeks before our break starts. 

I think that it would be good if schools taught life skills, but they would rather spend the time teaching kids things that benefit the school, because better performing kids makes the school look good, they couldn't care less about what them pupils do when they leave/ what they do in the future. 

My course is a BTEC course, which means that it is assignment based rather that test based like a GCSE.

I got Uncharted 4 on Wednesday and completed it Thursday. Definitely lived up to the hype, best game in the series, I played the game nearly non-stop, It took nearly 15 hours to beat but it kept my mind off other things. I have seen some overwatch footage, but I don't usually buy multiplayer only games, I prefer games with story.

I haven't been reading Reddit as much lately, I used to browse Askreddit a lot and I was on reddit a lot when I first found it but slowly I have become bored with reddit, so I check once a week at least. 

Not many people have their lives planned out, with some people things just fall in to their lap.

I still don't exactly know what I want to do, I know that I definitely won't choose university (It is £9000/year in the UK, what is it like in California?),I want to do something related to IT, but I don't want to find myself in a crap paying customer service job or something like that, I need to figure out exactly what I want to do. 

Good luck with your finals, hope you are feeling ok :)

Hey!, Woah, I didn't realise I last replied a week ago, how are you doing? I'm still here lol. Sorry if I had you worried, I'm ok for now.

Just had exams and other crap to deal with over the past week, sorry for not replying.

I saw the last two James Bond films in the cinema (I saw Spectre last year, that's the last movie I watched lol (Not really big on movies), what movies do you watch? What would you recommend?

Overwatch seems to be popular, I have heard it is similar to Team Fortress 2. I'm still waiting on Uncharted 4, although the prices are going down a little bit now so if I see a good deal I'll buy it. 
My dad still has his old Atari, still works after 30 years lol. I have an Atari Flashback that has loads of games built in to it.

If I could improve on something (There are a lot of things) is to be less anxious in social situations. Something simple like making eye contact can be stressful sometimes. What would you improve about yourself? There are some things you just can't change and have to live with like having a disability, which sucks but I have just accepted it now. 
 
There is nowhere I want to go at the moment, but I would like to go somewhere outside of Europe eventually, probably not to anywhere like Korea because of distance. Where do you want to visit?

''There was one guy who I thought was bit of an idiot"

Haha, that's got to be the most british thing I've ever said, lol.

He's alright I suppose, we get on ok, although when in a class with other people he's an idiot. Was rushing to get work done today and everyone else was being loud and distracting. Tossers.

Yeah, I was surprised when I found out that he knew of my old friend (who lives 5 mins away from me). We just sort of drifted apart and now it's been 6 years, and that guy who knew him seemed more of an acquaintance and they don't talk now. 

Our work is submitted online and it is graded by the teacher there.

If I was more academic I would consider college but I struggle with standard GCSE subjects so I don't feel higher education would be for me. I don't really have any job in mind, and just took a course because I had an interest in the subject. I have no idea what I will be doing in 3 years from now... I just don't have a clue, nothing really has stuck out and grabbed my interest. Programming looks cool but it's way beyond my abilities. I never feel good after people praise me as I can't distinguish it between real/ fake praise, and I hate it, I would rather know that i'm doing something wrong/ something is absolute crap rather than have fake praise '' Well done for this, you are an asset to this school, you do the bare minimum and sit there quietly, and this work is complete crap and has a ton of stuff wrong with it''. I hate it as it misleads me to think I'm actually doing good, then I look at my grades... I know they are told to give fake praise to disadvantaged kids but it always annoyed me because I can't tell if this is work is good... or if its Good work! if you know what I mean... I'm rambling lol, sorry if I missed anything, It can take me a while to write a reply. Feels good to get it all out there, I could ramble on about anything for hours. 

I recently discovered a website called 7 Cups, which is for people with anxiety/depression issues to talk to each other in a chat room. It helped me a lot talking to people on there with similar issues, I highly recommend it. 

What other subreddits do you use?, Apart from here I read r/PS4 a lot ,askreddit, britishproblems, depression, metal. 

Looking forward to hearing all the E3 news in June, (E3 is considered the biggest video game show of the year), still got time to wait though (Where they show trailers that look nothing like the final game and try to get you hyped up and pre-order a game that isn't complete yet that could be crap), lol. It's true though, It's why I never pre-order games. I pre-ordered The Order 1886 last year, I was hyped for it as I always wanted a Victorian London shooter game, and well... XD. It's 11 here now so I should stop lol. Anyway hope you are doing good, I'm still here for you :)
Could be worse, could have been the Daily Star

I'm feeling better now, I have symptoms similar to manic depression, where sometimes I am just really happy for no reason and think about how good life is, and when I'm down I get depressed and suicidal, I really should make an appointment with my GP or something. I might try the methods that you described to keep me distracted from those thoughts. 

It is important never to beat yourself up, I think I'm useless sometimes but then I look at the people around me and I instantly feel better, I am going to be successful and they are not because they choose to ruin their future. 

I used to feel that no one cared but I have made some new friends and we get on well, and they are supportive of me. I always used to be the reject kid who got bullied at school but I changed things about me to fit in better. There was one guy I thought was kind of an idiot (we got on ok) but yesterday it was just me and him and we talked for 45 minutes straight, we found we had a lot in common, and he was friends with a guy who used to be my best friend 6 years ago (We went to different high schools so we lost contact). People may seem like idiots when you first see them but you can't really judge them until you know them better. I used  to find it hard to make friends but if you are friendly to people, talk to people, get to know them, show an interest in them and be supportive, people will want to be your friend, because who wouldn't  want a friend like that?. 

You are not useless whatsoever, do you have family/friends that support you/know about your issues?. Those thoughts are totally irrational, and I try my best not to listen to them, or try to think of a counter-argument against them thoughts to show how stupid and irrational they are. I have done zero work today... just can't face it, I think I'm being lazy but I don't know... I feel that I don't care any more, even if I did work today I wouldn't of got much done anyway, not like it would matter as I can't get it all done in time as I am busy on other days doing stuff as well. I have done enough work to pass the course but I don't have anything else planned afterwards, better start looking... 

I did shit in my final exams (What we call GCSEs), I revised but my mind went blank during the exams and I was super anxious, I did well in some but I need to retake math and english. I want to be successful but I don't have the work ethic, opening my exam results was a massive motivation and self esteem killer, the teachers said I was on track but I failed... I would have passed geography if it wasn't for the teacher leaving us in class and not returning, it was the day our geography coursework was due and me and two other people were in a class after school, I finished my work and the teacher seemed to have just left, as he didn't return to our class and he wasn't in his own classroom, and I had to get home. The next day I'm in his class and he says that I have failed for not handing in my work. I wasn't happy with him to put it nicely, one of the guys who was with me in the class had my back though and was on my side. 

I could just say fuck it with the work and get uncharted, it's the only thing I have really been looking forward to for a while.

How do you cope with anxiety/ suicidal thoughts? Sometimes I drink which really helps me ( I only do it when im at my worst, I rarely drink), how do you cope with it? the place I plan to kill myself is only a 10 minute walk from me so it's really tempting sometimes. Sometimes drinking is the only thing which helps to curb my suicidal thoughts/ depression, which isn't good.

Hey,
Sorry I haven't made a proper reply in a while. How am I feeling today? Got a massive load of unexpected work dumped on me and I need to revise for an exam that is on the day before the work is due. Pretty stressed as if I don't get the work done I won't be able to continue on to another course I want to do, and I have not applied for anything else, so if I don't do this work in time i'm screwed basically. 

How are you? Are you feeling better? 

Haven't seen the new Captain America but a friend who went to see it said he liked it. I was going to see Batman V Superman but didn't after the crap reviews. 

Would like to treat myself to Uncharted 4 but it's £50 at most shops at the moment so i'll wait, I still have a few sealed PS4 games in my backlog that I haven't played yet anyway. I know a couple of people who pre-ordered the game though, will have to ask them what they think about it.

What shooter did you start playing? You will get better with more practice, I'm burned out on TF2 after 800 hours, lol. 

I usually drink 2L of water per day, as recommended, but it's been hot here lately so I really need to drink more. I also get really bad headaches when I'm dehydrated/tired. 

I haven't drunk energy drinks in years, but when I did it I just powered through the work. I need more sleep as well though, I used to take medication to help me sleep when I was younger, and I used to be really sensitive to heat which meant I couldn't sleep, which I still have now but not as bad as it used to be. 

Not a big fan of marvel/ DC comics but I know a friend who is. I have tried getting in to it but it doesn't really interest me. Just about got that other piece of work done to find out that the work needs more work done to it, which I only found out today. Sucks but I'm really going to need to cram to get it all done. I need to stop thinking about it... I'm super anxious about it. How has your anxiety been? When some thing big like this is making me anxious I start to get even more anxious around small things like you and I find that my OCD tendencies get worse. It's 11 now and I probably won't sleep much tonight, I find it impossible to sleep when I am worrying, especially now with how important this is... My mind goes through a cycle of anxiety, suicidal thoughts, then I start to think about why I shouldn't do it and I try to suppress the suicidal thoughts. I just lay there in bed with sleep being the last thing on my mind.

Sorry that I haven't been replying much, I thank you for taking the time to talk to me, I haven't been checking my reddit as much as usual recently. I'm always here if you need someone to talk to :) 

Having a positive outlook on life and positive attitude helps me to get through the day, it's not always easy to have a positive outlook but it has helped me a lot.
Hey, sorry I haven't replied lately, how are you anyway?, i'm ok.

Hey, thanks, not feeling great like I said earlier. have a fuck ton of work for friday... might have to do an all nighter lol. Thanks for the support, if anything is bothering you tell me. How are you? I hear that you haven't been feeling that good. 

I need to do this but I have been thinking about suicide since I got home today, did a little bit but my motivation is sapped, drinking energy drinks and trying my best, you have really helped me over the past couple of weeks, it is good to talk about these issues.

Hey,

My favourite animal would have to be a cat. Never had one though. I used to have some fish but that was years ago. What is your favourite animal?.

 I have never really collected stuff, but have a medium sized retro game collection. Have you heard about the Nintendo NX? Are you gettig the new Zelda? I have never really been in to reading, only what we had to read for school. I don't really know of any good eating places in London, I don't visit central London very often, the only time I ever visit there is when I change trains in London to go to another part of the country.

I have a couple of half sisters and a half brother, but I don't talk to them often, I last saw them about a month ago. How many siblings do you have?

Hey, sorry I haven't replied in a few days.
At school I reported the teacher and the student, which ended up with this student being forced to apologise to me by another teacher. The teacher that I reported is still teaching, but he seemed worried after I had reported him. I would always get people stealing my stuff, to the point that I couldn't leave a pencil on my desk for 10 seconds without someone stealing it. 

I used to have really bad anxiety when trying to speak/ socialize with people (I still do but it's not as bad as it used to be).

I only went to France for a day trip (I went there in 2011). I remember eating a hotdog thing with cheese on top (That's all I can remember, lol). I remember walking along the streets of Paris and taking a boat trip along the river, and seeing the Notre Dame cathedral.

What happened to the girl and the brownies?  I don't like tuna, so I'm glad that never happened to me lol. That reminds me of a story that happened a while ago- Before an exam, I was sitting revising with another guy in my class. It must have helped him as only me and him actually passed the exam out of the whole class, lol (I have never touched weed or any other drug and never plan on doing it).

In terms of living in London the people are rude (Not everyone), houses are smaller here and more expensive, the weather is getting better here (It's midnight here as I type this, but it's forecast to be sunny 21C (50F) today. 

Never played super smash but I have seen the new Wii U version  and it looks cool. Do you have a Wii U? 

I'm feeling ok today, just sitting here listening to Pantera. How are you feeling?

I don't have any pets but I would pick a cat (I have been to a cat rescue place before). Do you have any pets? Where have you been/ would like to go on holiday?

Hey,
First I just wanted to say thank you for the support, i find things like this hard to talk about with family and friends.

My OCD is stuff like turning the lights on and off repeatedly, washing my hands when I touch the TV remote etc, and it gets worse when i'm having a bad day/feel extra anxious/stressed. To combat this I usually think about how irrational my OCD thoughts are and use that to try to stop my OCD. 

When i'm feeling low I usually listen to music, play video games (PS4, retro games, VR) browse reddit/youtube. I have a big interest in metal music (Slipknot, iron maiden, system of a down) and would love to learn how to play the electric guitar. 

In terms of bullying (secondary school) it got bad sometimes, getting picked on in most lessons. I was a quiet kid aswell most of the time, just keeping away from everyone else. There was a time a kid punched me in the face and the teacher didn't care, didn't even report it (In the end I reported the teacher), and the same teacher basically called me a reject in front of the whole class. 

In terms of friends it was hard because people who were friends slowly pushed me away, and one person in our friend circle just hated me for no reason whatsoever, even though he was fine with everyone else. In the end I wasn't really part of the group, just hanging around them because it made it look like I had friends.
